about.body: PureClear ek hi wajah se hai: aapki files se aapki zindagi leak nahi honi chahiye. Har photo me chhupa data hota hai — kahan li gayi, kis device se, kab. Hum use hatate hain, aapke device par, aapki files dekhe bina.

how.step1Body: Files aapka device kabhi nahi chhodti. Sab kuch aapke browser me chalta hai.
how.step2Body: EXIF, GPS, XMP aur document properties detect karke aapko dikhaye jaate hain.
